memories.content: The Campus Store on the first floor of the Main Building operates from 7:00 a.m. to 11:00 p.m. even during recess.
The Engineering Building Campus Store's usual operating hours during recess are from 9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m.
The cafe on the first floor of the Main Building operates during summer break as well.
The dining area on the first floor of the Main Building operates during summer break as well.
There is a coffee machine inside the Innovation Hub on the first floor of the Main Building.
Only staff may use the coffee machine inside the Innovation Hub on the first floor of the Main Building.
The ATM in the West Complex is separate from the ATM inside the Main Building.
The ATM in the West Complex is in the building next to Outdoor Parking Lot A.
Students who need cash in the evening often expect that they can use the Main Building ATM at any time.
Students who need basic items late at night expect the 24-hour store in the Main Building to be open.
Identify and provide guidance to an alternative location of the same type as the closed facility.
Do not treat the facilities in the West Complex and the facilities in the Main Building as the same place.
The amenities information agent can answer with posted locations.
The amenities information agent can answer with posted operating hours.
The amenities information agent cannot check product inventory.
The amenities information agent cannot check whether payment is available.
The amenities information agent cannot check unexpected closures on the day.
The Campus Store contractor incorporates students' tendency to use the Main Building ATM and the 24-hour store together in the evening into demand planning.
The Engineering Building Campus Store sells school supplies and basic household goods.
The return conditions for the Main Building Campus Store are posted in the store's receipt guidance.
Each store determines the prices of products sold at the Campus Store.
The Main Building dining area's menu for the day is posted on the menu board at the entrance.
Labels for major allergens in the dining menu can be found on the menu board.
The food and beverage information agent cannot guarantee that there is no cross-contact in the food preparation area.
Vegetarian options are indicated by dietary symbols on the menu board for the day.
There is a water fountain for filling personal water bottles on the first floor of the Main Building.
General seating at the Main Building cafe cannot be reserved individually.
The common lounge in the Student Centre has a microwave that users can use.
There is a beverage vending machine on the second floor of the Main Building.
There is a snack vending machine on the fifth floor of the Main Building.
The ATMs in the Main Building and the West Complex are managed by different operators.
The amenities information agent cannot access ATM transaction history or determine the cause of transaction errors.
Contact the operator of the relevant ATM regarding a retained ATM card or transaction error.
The operating hours of the visitor services desk are posted on the Main Building information page.
The visitor services desk provides campus maps and public facility information.
General facility inquiries can be submitted through the public online inquiry form.
Student support services that handle personal records require identity verification.
Visitors can use the campus's public guest network.
Instructions for connecting to the guest network are posted in the visitor services information.
The Engineering Building Campus Store is in a separate building from the Main Building and can be reached by a public pedestrian route that does not pass through the Main Building.
The amenities information agent cannot access a user's purchase history.
The food and beverage information agent must not infer ingredient composition that is not listed on the menu.
The operating hours of each campus shop and food and beverage facility may vary on public holidays.
Check the relevant store's official notice for extended operating hours during exam periods.
The store operator determines product inventory and availability for sale.
Students with long intervals between classes prefer the dining area on the first floor of the Main Building as a comfortable place to wait.
External visitors often expect to be able to use a cafe in the same building as a public event.
The reusable container return bin is next to the exit of the dining area on the first floor of the Main Building.
The Main Building dining area has wheelchair-accessible seating.
Direct users to report service issues to the relevant facility's posted contact point.
Add campus-wiki/route-changes: The indoor route that passed through the first through third floors of the Main Building to the Central Library cannot be used during the construction period.
Add campus-wiki/route-changes: The route from the third-floor rear entrance to the Central Library is closed during the construction period.
Add campus-wiki/route-changes: The Outdoor Parking Lot A–Main Building–Central Library route is closed during the construction period.

Modify campus-wiki/route-changes: A student who prefers the air-conditioned indoor route through the Main Building in summer may experience substantial heat and travel burden when redirected to an outdoor alternative route during the construction period.

Add campus-wiki/route-changes: When providing directions to the accessible restroom in the Student Centre during the construction period, instruct users to take the accessible route to the left as viewed from the Main Building.

Add campus-wiki/route-changes: During the construction period, the designated alternative accessible route to the Central Library is Outdoor Parking Lot C–Student Centre accessible entrance–Central Library west entrance.

Add campus-wiki/route-changes: During the construction period, the Central Library west entrance is designated as the official alternative entrance for the closed connecting route through the Main Building.

Modify campus-wiki/route-changes: During the construction period, the route guidance agent may exclude from comparison candidates closed routes that pass through the first through third floors of the Main Building, the third-floor rear entrance, or Outdoor Parking Lot A.

Modify campus-wiki/route-changes: If the indoor shortcut through the Main Building is closed during the construction period, a mobility-support companion may reconfirm the distance and slope of the alternative accessible route before accompanying the user.

analysis.overview: The frames cover separate operational domains. The reference frame documents campus amenities, facility services, locations, hours, restrictions, and support boundaries, while the compared frame exclusively documents construction-period route closures, alternatives, accessibility directions, and traveler impacts. Neither side contains a claim directly comparable with the other.
